name: shipyard
description: A shipping pipeline for Claude Code. Triage sends large or hard work to the full cross-lab shipyard and the rest to a lighter boatyard. Both plan, review the plan, build in parallel git worktrees, review every task, polish tests and code, review the whole branch, and run the full test suite before the PR.

plugins.name: shipyard
plugins.description: Pinned models from three labs. Astra plans, Fable and a fresh Astra (plus opt-in Grok) attack the plan, Luna, Gemini Hydrogen and Neon build in parallel worktrees, Sol reviews each task (Opus as fallback), Neon audits the tests and lists simplifications, and Fable and Astra (plus opt-in Grok and Mythos) attack the branch before the PR. Boatyard does the same with Opus planning and Sonnet reviewing tasks.
